newsitem.title: USA: Pudgies's secures $5 mln in financing.
newsitem.headline: Pudgies's secures $5 mln in financing.

text.p: Pudgie's Chicken Inc on Monday said ReCap Partners LLC, a New York-based investment banking firm, agreed to provide $5 million in debtor-in-possession financing.

Pudgie's said in a statement that it would use the proceeds for working capital and to fund its reorganization plan. In September, the company filed a voluntary petition for reorganization under Chapter 11 of the U.S. Bankruptcy Code.
Pudgie's operates and franchises its chicken restaurants, which feature home delivery service.
